description.value:
Critical threshold −1. Each completed Basic grants one Dragon stack, maximum 2. Each stack lasts 2 wearer turns and grants attack bonus +1 and Energy Regeneration score +1. Display stacks and expiry in the GM panel; expire each independently.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching destruction Path required.
